integrity: Proof and computation were subjected to self-review; no independent audit, external certification or definitive historical-priority determination is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The statements cover smooth geometric members of the normalized characteristic-seven pencil y^3=x^5+a*x+1 and do not classify every cyclic trigonal curve, isomorphism classes, or full Ekedahl-Oort types. The zeta numerator is explicit only for the a=0 fiber. The four extension-field counts are exhaustive finite computations combined with the genus-four functional equation; generic Newton polygons come from a symbolic Cartier determinant.
title: The unique nonordinary member of a characteristic-seven genus-four trigonal pencil
